name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Shoulder Press
steps: Bring the dumbbell beside one shoulder, turn your palm forward and spread your feet for a steady base.
Brace your core and glutes, keeping your ribs down and your free arm out to the side or at your hip for stability.
Press the dumbbell straight overhead until your arm is fully extended with your biceps close to your ear.
Lower the weight slowly back to shoulder level, and switch arms after completing one side.
tips: Do not lean away from the working arm or hyperextend your lower back to force the weight up.
Keep your elbow slightly in front of your torso rather than flared straight back.
